en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka; English synthesis from the officially published Czech treaty text
en.text: Article 10 — Dividends. Dividends paid by a company resident in one Contracting State to a resident of the other State may also be taxed in the State of the paying company. If the beneficial owner is a company other than a partnership that directly owns at least 25 per cent of the capital of the paying company, the source-State tax shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross dividend. In all other cases where the recipient is the beneficial owner, the source-State tax shall not exceed 15 per cent. The reduced source rates do not apply where the holding is effectively connected with a permanent establishment or fixed base in the source State.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka; English synthesis from the officially published Czech treaty text
en.text: Article 11 — Interest. Interest arising in one Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other State may also be taxed in the source State. If the recipient is the beneficial owner, the source-State tax shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest. Notwithstanding that limit, qualifying interest involving a Contracting State, its political subdivision or local authority, or a bank or financial institution wholly owned by that State, is exempt in the source State under the conditions stated in paragraph 3. The reduced source treatment does not apply where the debt claim is effectively connected with a permanent establishment or fixed base in the source State.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka; English synthesis from the officially published Czech treaty text
en.text: Article 12 — Royalties. Royalties arising in one Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other State may also be taxed in the source State. If the recipient is the beneficial owner, the source-State tax shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties. The Article covers payments for the use of, or right to use, copyright and specified intellectual property, industrial, commercial or scientific equipment, and information concerning industrial, commercial or scientific experience. The reduced source rate does not apply where the relevant right or property is effectively connected with a permanent establishment or fixed base in the source State.
